heroes.name: Brood_Bot
heroes.blurb: A cheerful yellow robot on tank treads that builds spider-bots in its back bay and sends them skittering at the zombies.

heroes.name: Bub
heroes.blurb: A Day of the Dead zombie in a leather jacket and red flannel, face painted like a sugar skull. Swings his rotten arms, shoots a pistol and eats what he kills.

heroes.name: K-Swiss
heroes.blurb: Kyle: gamer, line cook, Magic player and dad. Support with a pistol and a hatchet; his boys Leif and Leon come running when he yells WOLF OUT!!!

heroes.name: JP
heroes.blurb: A bearded guy in a big orange hoodie with a Kar98, a sword and a homemade wooden shield. Probably high.

heroes.name: Tee_Grizzle
heroes.blurb: Big homie with a Drako and a hatchet. 3-round bursts, sweeps every lane with No_Effort, and hypes up his whole crew.

heroes.name: Shoshi
heroes.blurb: Kyle's cousin and go-to tech guy: purple hoodie, glasses, a headset and an Automatic_Pistol with a 20-round mag. Keeps everybody running.

heroes.name: Edward
heroes.blurb: A bearded guy with a short black fro and glasses, in a black hoodie, jeans and a tool belt, with a yellow nail gun and a heavy red toolbox.

heroes.name: Engineer
heroes.blurb: A hard-hatted engineer in a red shirt and overalls with a big wrench and a sawn-off. Builds towers, barriers, tesla coils and turrets.

heroes.name: Cheez
heroes.blurb: A neon-lit techno-samurai with short spiky black hair, glasses and a goatee, a beam katana and a bottle of neon sake.

heroes.name: Soldier
heroes.blurb: A helmeted soldier in a balaclava and plate carrier with an assault rifle and a bag of frag grenades.

heroes.name: Flannel_Man
heroes.blurb: A bearded drifter in green flannel with a bolt-action rifle and a crowbar.

heroes.name: Tide_Warrior
heroes.blurb: A small, fearless swordsman in a long brown coat.

heroes.name: Druid
heroes.blurb: A sea-green druid with a gnarled staff.

heroes.name: Lumber_Jack
heroes.blurb: A red-bearded lumberjack with an axe and a hunting bow.

heroes.name: Warhound
heroes.blurb: A hunched olive war-walker with brass trim: a flamethrower up close, a Targeted Lazer at range and a jetpack on its back.

heroes.name: Void_Cultist
heroes.blurb: A hooded void cultist with a bone mask and a ritual dagger.

heroes.name: Undead_Alchemist
heroes.blurb: A goggled alchemist, pale and bluish with dead white hair, who died in her own lab and got back up. Lobs flasks and keeps the team brewed up.

heroes.name: Crimson_Knight
heroes.blurb: An unholy knight in blackened plate with green hellfire burning in his chest, bound by a blood oath that outlived him.
